binary_detection.official_function_source:
def is_text_file(filename: str) -> bool:
    with open(filename, mode="rb") as f:
        s = f.read(1024)
    return b"\x00" not in s
binary_detection.rule: Open as bytes, read the first 1024 bytes, classify as text only if that window has no NUL byte. It does not inspect the extension or recognize gzip magic.

name: Codespell

on:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  codespell:
    timeout-minutes: 30
    name: Check for spelling errors

name: blocking-ci

on:
  pull_request: {}
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: blocking-ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  scope:
    name: Select blocking CI scope
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      inference: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.inference }}
      effects: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.effects }}
      lifecycle: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.lifecycle }}
      learning: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.learning }}
      objective: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.objective }}
      native: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.native }}
      derived: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.derived }}
      full_repo: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.full_repo }}
      ndu_v6: ${{ steps.ndu_v6.outputs.selected }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Select dependency impact
        id: scope
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest -v scripts.tests.test_hepta_ci_scope scripts.tests.test_hepta_ci_dependencies
          python3 -m unittest -v scripts.test_hepta_readiness_semantics
          args=(--head "$HEAD_SHA" --github-output "$GITHUB_OUTPUT")
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            args+=(--base "$BASE_SHA")
          else
            args+=(--full)
          fi
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_scope.py "${args[@]}"

      - name: Select v6 rollout and native dependency changes
        id: ndu_v6
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os
          from scripts.hepta_ci_scope import changed_paths
          prefixes = (
              "experiments/multimodal_output_portfolio/", "codex-rs/hepta-ndu/",
              "codex-rs/hepta-types/", "codex-rs/hepta-contracts/", "codex-rs/.cargo/",
              "codex-rs/hepta-infer-core/", "codex-rs/hepta-infer-worker-host/",
              "codex-rs/hepta-agentd/src/test_support.rs",
          )
          shared = {
              "codex-rs/Cargo.toml", "codex-rs/Cargo.lock", "codex-rs/rust-toolchain.toml",
              "justfile", "scripts/run-nextest.py", "scripts/just-shell.py",
              "scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py", "scripts/hepta_ci_scope.py",
              "scripts/verify_cargo_lock.py", ".github/workflows/ndu-v6.yml",
              ".github/workflows/blocking-ci.yml",
          }
          selected = os.environ["EVENT_NAME"] != "pull_request" or any(
              path.startswith(prefixes) or path in shared
              for path in changed_paths(os.environ["BASE_SHA"], os.environ["HEAD_SHA"])
          )
          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
              output.write(f"selected={str(selected).lower()}\n")
          PY

      - name: Regression-test scoped fan-in policy
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          NEEDS='{"scope":{"result":"success"},"heavy":{"result":"skipped"}}' \
            ALLOWED_SKIPPED='["heavy"]' \
            python3 .github/scripts/check_ci_results.py
          if NEEDS='{"scope":{"result":"success"},"heavy":{"result":"skipped"}}' \
            python3 .github/scripts/check_ci_results.py; then
            echo "unscoped skipped dependency was incorrectly accepted" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

  hepta-contract-gate:
    name: Hepta contract gate
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.native == 'true' || needs.scope.outputs.full_repo == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/hepta-contract-gate.yml
    with:
      profile: development
    secrets: inherit

  bazel:
    name: Bazel
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.full_repo == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/bazel.yml
    secrets: inherit

  blob-size-policy:
    name: Blob size policy
    uses: ./.github/workflows/blob-size-policy.yml
    secrets: inherit

  cargo-deny:
    name: cargo-deny
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.full_repo == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/cargo-deny.yml
    secrets: inherit

  codespell:
    name: Codespell
    uses: ./.github/workflows/codespell.yml
    secrets: inherit

  ndu-v6:
    name: NDU v6 neural rollout smoke
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.ndu_v6 == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ndu-v6.yml

  repo-checks:
    name: repo-checks
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.full_repo == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/repo-checks.yml
    secrets: inherit

  rust-ci:
    name: rust-ci
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.full_repo == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/rust-ci.yml
    secrets: inherit

  sdk:
    name: sdk
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.full_repo == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/sdk.yml
    secrets: inherit

  hepta-scoped:
    name: Hepta scoped native checks
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.native == 'true' && needs.scope.outputs.full_repo != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare native test prerequisites before compilation
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential bubblewrap libcap-dev pkg-config
          sudo sysctl -w kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=1
          if sysctl kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
          fi
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@44c6d64aa62cd779e873306675c7a58e86d6d532
        with:
          tool: just@1.51.0,nextest@0.9.103
      - uses: facebook/install-dotslash@1e4e7b3e07eaca387acb98f1d4720e0bee8dbb6a
      - run: sudo install -m 0755 "$(command -v dotslash)" /usr/local/bin/dotslash
      - name: Resolve verified V8 artifacts for affected host crates
        env:
          CODEX_REPO_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
          PYTHONPATH: scripts
        run: python3 scripts/hepta_ci_v8.py

      - name: Test affected owners and reverse consumers, not a hand-written package list
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          TESTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          HEPTA_CI_LANE: source-head
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_exec.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/impact-test.json" --
          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_dependencies.py --base "$BASE_SHA" --tested "$TESTED_SHA"
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-impact.json" --run

      - name: Retain dependency plan and real command output
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: hepta-cargo-impact-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/cargo-impact.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/impact-test.json*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Verify generated projections when applicable
        if: needs.scope.outputs.derived == 'true'
        run: python3 scripts/hepta-module-docs.py refresh-derived --check

  lightweight:
    name: Lightweight prose and derived checks
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.native != 'true' && needs.scope.outputs.full_repo != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify lightweight repository consistency
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --check
          python3 scripts/asciicheck.py README.md
          python3 scripts/readme_toc.py README.md
          python3 scripts/hepta-module-docs.py refresh-derived --check
          python3 scripts/hepta-docs.py verify --profile development
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"

  required:
    timeout-minutes: 30
    name: CI required
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs:
      - scope
      - hepta-contract-gate
      - bazel
      - blob-size-policy
      - cargo-deny
      - codespell
      - ndu-v6
      - repo-checks
      - rust-ci
      - sdk
      - hepta-scoped
      - lightweight
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require successful applicable dependencies
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          NATIVE: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.native }}
          FULL_REPO: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.full_repo }}
          NDU_V6: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.ndu_v6 }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export ALLOWED_SKIPPED="$(
            python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          native = os.environ["NATIVE"] == "true"
          full = os.environ["FULL_REPO"] == "true"
          allowed = []
          if os.environ["NDU_V6"] != "true":
              allowed.append("ndu-v6")
          if not (native or full):
              allowed.append("hepta-contract-gate")
          if not full:
              allowed += ["bazel", "cargo-deny", "repo-checks", "rust-ci", "sdk"]
          if not (native and not full):
              allowed.append("hepta-scoped")
          if not (not native and not full):
              allowed.append("lightweight")
          print(json.dumps(allowed))
          PY
          )"
          python3 .github/scripts/check_ci_results.py

inherited_same_tree_proof.method: Nonrecursive Git trees of experiments at the base and fixed head; both responses truncated=false. Equal subtree Git object IDs prove the entire corresponding directory contents and descendants are unchanged.

safe_publication_transport_proposal.method: Partition the already-compressed byte stream into payloads no larger than 480000 bytes; encode each payload as a complete deterministic gzip container using mtime=0, with a truthful .gz suffix. A separate publication bootstrap verifies container SHA256, decodes each independent container, reconstructs the original compressed stream and verifies its unchanged original SHA256 before the frozen restoration code is called.
required_invariants: Original scientific members and their member hashes stay unchanged.
The concatenated decoded compressed stream must exactly match its previous compressed SHA256.
Retain original fixed-commit manifests and source identities; record any publication envelope separately.
Check each actual outer gzip container against the 512000-byte repository limit; a payload limit by itself is not the final size check.
Do not edit skip patterns, word lists, CI scope or frozen source to suppress findings.
safe_publication_transport_proposal.why_binary_detection_is_correct: The standard gzip header itself contains NUL bytes. This is a valid gzip container, not a file disguised as a skipped text format or bytes patched into the historical payload.

scope: Read-only diagnosis of the specified failed CI job, fixed-head configuration and inherited subtrees; a small standard-gzip transport probe was executed in /tmp. Only this new diagnosis file was written in the repository. No scientific source, protocol, original evidence, CI policy or word list was changed.

semantic_context.first_passage_abbreviation: 78 inherited findings concern the scientific first-passage-time abbreviation; the suggested file-transfer-protocol spelling would change the meaning.
semantic_context.historical_labels_and_paths: Other inherited findings occur in scientific source, protocols, evidence metadata and external source identifiers; no bulk replacement is justified. They are outside this R13 change.

standard_gzip_small_probe.full_cli_limitation: The local package is absent.
